title: Add read-only customer order and receipt reconciliation report
description: Add a read-only operational reconciliation report over existing Sales Orders, authoritative shipment progress and receipt links already exposed by ERP-032. The report must distinguish ordered, shipped, linked-receipt, unlinked and unknown evidence without claiming to be an accounts-receivable ledger, customer statement of account, payment allocation engine or aging report. Do not infer links, settle balances, rewrite orders or receipts, execute production SQL, deploy, or release.
acceptance_criteria: The report groups active Sales Order and receipt evidence by Customer and currency and never combines different currencies into one monetary total.

For each Sales Order, ordered and shipment quantities reuse the authoritative ERP-032 rules, while linked receipt amounts use only persisted authoritative references already supported by that workflow.
Receipts without an authoritative order reference are shown separately as unlinked evidence and are never matched by Customer name, order number text, date or amount similarity.
Missing, ambiguous or unavailable receipt coverage is displayed as unknown and is not converted to zero, paid, outstanding or overdue.
Cancelled or deleted operational records are excluded from active totals but remain available only where an existing historical status filter can represent them without rewriting source data.

The UI and documentation clearly state that the report is an operational order/receipt reconciliation view, not an accounts-receivable ledger, legal customer statement, payment authorization, settlement result or aging report.
Users can filter by Customer, currency, order date, shipment state and receipt-linkage state; normal queries are bounded or paged and avoid per-row database queries.
The report is read-only and does not update Sales Orders, stock-out records, receipts, Customer credit state, inventory, finance records or tax records.

Unit/integration tests cover multiple Customers and currencies, full and partial shipment, linked and unlinked receipts, unknown coverage, filters, paging and source-record non-mutation; safe validation passes.
Browser/UI acceptance is recorded as deferred during development according to project policy.

scenarios: Open the customer order/receipt reconciliation report and inspect an order with partial shipment and authoritative partial receipt linkage in one currency.
Filter for unlinked or unknown receipt evidence and verify it is not presented as paid, outstanding, overdue or automatically matched to an order.

human_gate.reason: Read-only reporting over repository records. No production mutation, receipt settlement, customer credit decision, deployment or release is authorized.
